questions.stem_md: Konus asosining radiusi $16$ ga, o'q kesimining yuzi $192$ ga teng. Konusning yon sirtining yuzini toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220"><rect x="0" y="0" width="320" height="220" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="98,172 222,172 160,44" fill="#c7d2fe" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#c7d2fe" stroke-width="0.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="98" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 0 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 1 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="160" y2="44" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="172" r="2" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="191" y="190.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">r</text><text x="138" y="134.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">S</text></svg>
figure.alt: Konus va uning o'q kesimi (uchburchak, yuzi 192); asosining radiusi 16.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{192}{16}=12$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{256+144}=20$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot16\cdot20=320\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yasovchi o'rniga balandlikni olish ($\pi rh$) yoki asos yuzini qo'shib yuborish.

ru.solution_md:
Осевое сечение — равнобедренный треугольник с основанием $2r$ и высотой $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, значит $h=\frac{192}{16}=12$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{256+144}=20$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot16\cdot20=320\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Взять вместо образующей высоту ($\pi rh$) или добавить площадь основания.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is an isosceles triangle with base $2r$ and height $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, so $h=\frac{192}{16}=12$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{256+144}=20$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot16\cdot20=320\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height ($\pi rh$), or adding the base area.

questions.solution_md:
Balandlikni o'q kesimidagi to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakdan topamiz: katetlari $h$ va $r_1-r_2=12$, gipotenuzasi $l=20$. $h=\sqrt{400-144}=16$.

$V=\frac{\pi h}{3}(r_1^2+r_1r_2+r_2^2)=\frac{\pi\cdot16}{3}(196+28+4)=1216\pi$.

ru.solution_md:
Высоту найдём из прямоугольного треугольника в осевом сечении: катеты $h$ и $r_1-r_2=12$, гипотенуза $l=20$. $h=\sqrt{400-144}=16$.

$V=\frac{\pi h}{3}(r_1^2+r_1r_2+r_2^2)=\frac{\pi\cdot16}{3}(196+28+4)=1216\pi$.

en.solution_md:
We find the height from the right triangle in the axial section: the legs are $h$ and $r_1-r_2=12$, the hypotenuse is $l=20$. $h=\sqrt{400-144}=16$.

$V=\frac{\pi h}{3}(r_1^2+r_1r_2+r_2^2)=\frac{\pi\cdot16}{3}(196+28+4)=1216\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Substituting the slant height for the height, or dropping the term $r_1r_2$ in the formula.

questions.stem_md: Konus asosining radiusi $24$ ga, o'q kesimining yuzi $240$ ga teng. Konusning yon sirtining yuzini toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220"><rect x="0" y="0" width="320" height="220" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="98,172 222,172 160,44" fill="#c7d2fe" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#c7d2fe" stroke-width="0.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="98" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 0 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 1 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="160" y2="44" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="172" r="2" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="191" y="190.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">r</text><text x="138" y="134.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">S</text></svg>

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{240}{24}=10$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{576+100}=26$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot24\cdot26=624\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yasovchi o'rniga balandlikni olish ($\pi rh$) yoki asos yuzini qo'shib yuborish.

ru.stem_md: Радиус основания конуса равен $24$, а площадь осевого сечения равна $240$. Найдите площадь боковой поверхности конуса.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220"><rect x="0" y="0" width="320" height="220" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="98,172 222,172 160,44" fill="#c7d2fe" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#c7d2fe" stroke-width="0.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="98" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 0 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 1 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="160" y2="44" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="172" r="2" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="191" y="190.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">r</text><text x="138" y="134.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">S</text></svg>

ru.solution_md:
Осевое сечение — равнобедренный треугольник с основанием $2r$ и высотой $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, значит $h=\frac{240}{24}=10$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{576+100}=26$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot24\cdot26=624\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Взять вместо образующей высоту ($\pi rh$) или добавить площадь основания.

en.stem_md: The base radius of a cone is $24$ and the area of its axial section is $240$. Find the lateral surface area of the cone.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is an isosceles triangle with base $2r$ and height $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, so $h=\frac{240}{24}=10$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{576+100}=26$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot24\cdot26=624\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height ($\pi rh$), or adding the base area.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{120}{15}=8$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{225+64}=17$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot15\cdot17=255\pi$.

questions.solution_md:
Hajm formulalari: $V=\pi R^2h$, $V=\frac13\pi R^2h$, $V=\frac43\pi R^3$.

$V_1=\pi\cdot2^2\cdot7=28\pi$

$V_2=\frac13\pi\cdot7^2\cdot5=\frac{245}{3}\pi$

$V_3=\frac43\pi\cdot3^3=36\pi$

1 → E;  2 → B;  3 → D

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{48}{8}=6$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{64+36}=10$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot8\cdot10=80\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yasovchi o'rniga balandlikni olish ($\pi rh$) yoki asos yuzini qo'shib yuborish.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{432}{18}=24$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{324+576}=30$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot18\cdot30=540\pi$.

figure.alt: A cone and its axial section (a triangle of area 432); base radius 18.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is an isosceles triangle with base $2r$ and height $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, so $h=\frac{432}{18}=24$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{324+576}=30$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot18\cdot30=540\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height ($\pi rh$), or adding the base area.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{420}{20}=21$.

en.stem_md: The base radius of a cone is $20$ and the area of its axial section is $420$. Find the lateral surface area of the cone.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220"><rect x="0" y="0" width="320" height="220" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="98,172 222,172 160,44" fill="#c7d2fe" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#c7d2fe" stroke-width="0.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="98" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="160" y1="44" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 0 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M 98 172 A 62 18.6 0 0 1 222 172" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="160" y2="44" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="160" y1="172" x2="222" y2="172" fill="none" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="172" r="2" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="191" y="190.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">r</text><text x="138" y="134.6" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">S</text></svg>
figure.alt: A cone and its axial section (a triangle of area 420); base radius 20.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is an isosceles triangle with base $2r$ and height $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, so $h=\frac{420}{20}=21$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{400+441}=29$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot20\cdot29=580\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height ($\pi rh$), or adding the base area.

questions.solution_md:
Hajm formulalari: $V=\pi R^2h$, $V=\frac13\pi R^2h$, $V=\frac43\pi R^3$.

$V_1=\pi\cdot5^2\cdot7=175\pi$

$V_2=\frac13\pi\cdot9^2\cdot3=81\pi$

$V_3=\frac43\pi\cdot2^3=\frac{32}{3}\pi$

1 → A;  2 → C;  3 → D

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{108}{9}=12$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{81+144}=15$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot9\cdot15=135\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yasovchi o'rniga balandlikni olish ($\pi rh$) yoki asos yuzini qo'shib yuborish.

O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{60}{5}=12$.

en.solution_md:

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot5\cdot13=65\pi$.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is an isosceles triangle with base $2r$ and height $h$: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, so $h=\frac{168}{7}=24$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{49+576}=25$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot7\cdot25=175\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height ($\pi rh$), or adding the base area.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — asosi $2r$, balandligi $h$ bo'lgan teng yonli uchburchak: $S=\frac12\cdot2r\cdot h=rh$, demak $h=\frac{300}{15}=20$.

$l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}=\sqrt{225+400}=25$.

$S_{l}=\pi rl=\pi\cdot15\cdot25=375\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yasovchi o'rniga balandlikni olish ($\pi rh$) yoki asos yuzini qo'shib yuborish.

ru.stem_md: Радиус основания конуса равен $16$, высота — $30$. Найдите площадь боковой поверхности.
ru.mistake_note_md: Используют высоту вместо образующей либо забывают $\frac{1}{3}$ в формуле объёма.

kaa.stem_md: Konustıń tiykar radiusı $16$, biyikligi $30$. Jan betin tabıń.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Jasawshı ornına biyiklikti qollanıw yamasa kólem formulasında $\frac{1}{3}$ di umıtıw.

en.stem_md: A cone has base radius $16$ and height $30$. Find its lateral surface area.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the height instead of the slant height, or forgetting $\frac{1}{3}$ in the volume.
